## 1. Database Schema Updates

- [x] 1.1 Add `rejection_reason` column (text/nullable) to `ir_content_details` table.
- [x] 1.2 Create `ir_official_posts` table (or adapt existing) to store EO official posts with `event_id`, `eo_id`, `content`, `image_url`.
- [x] 1.3 Create `ir_blast_messages` table to store `eo_id`, `group_ids` (array or JSON), `content`, `image_url`.

## 2. Admin CMS Improvements

- [x] 2.1 Update `AdminEvents.tsx` to support full Edit functionality (open a modal or route to an Edit page).
- [x] 2.2 In the Admin Event Edit form, add a Lineup dropdown to modify `contents_id`.
- [x] 2.3 Implement the "Event Review" queue (either a new tab in `AdminEvents.tsx` or a new page) that filters for `status = 2`.
- [x] 2.4 Add "Accept" button logic to update status to `1`.
- [x] 2.5 Add "Deny" button logic with a prompt for `rejection_reason` and update status to `3`.

## 3. EO CMS Improvements

- [x] 3.1 Update `EOCreateEvent.tsx` to set `status = 2` upon creation instead of immediate approval (already partially done, ensure it's enforced).
- [x] 3.2 Update `EOEvents.tsx` to display the `status` (Live, Pending, Rejected).
- [x] 3.3 For Rejected events, display the `rejection_reason` and add an "Edit & Resubmit" action.
- [x] 3.4 Build `EOPosts.tsx` page to allow EOs to create text/photo posts linked to their approved events.
- [x] 3.5 Build `EOBlast.tsx` page to allow EOs to select groups, attach a photo, type a message, and submit.

## 4. React Native App Integration

- [x] 4.1 Update `EventDetailScreen.tsx` to fetch data from the new Official Posts table and render it in the horizontal scroll section.
- [x] 4.2 Create a UI component/modal in the app to display Blast Messages.
- [x] 4.3 Implement polling or a Supabase Realtime listener in the React Native app to detect and trigger incoming Blast Messages for the user's groups.
